propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; only the test fake implements a remote_ref() port member that the Backend protocol does not declare

RemoteRef.instance must be populated from the normalized base URL at backend construction time and injected as a constructor parameter, not resolved at call time, to ensure contract tests work without ambient config
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent collision between two same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives the local ticket ID from the Jira key alone, independent of instance
vendor field already separates Cloud from DataCenter; instance only disambiguates two deployments of the same vendor
Both ADRs 0055 and 0035 must be amended to correct the docstring claim that instance prevents same-vendor collision and to document that RemoteRef is never persisted to disk
